nodes.label: creditedStreak
nodes.rationale: Remembers the streak value already paid a bonus so growth isn't paid twice.

nodes.label: Streak (skips weekends and leave)
nodes.rationale: Computed from session logs each time, not stored, so edits and leaves correct it.

nodes.label: Local dates with noon arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Date arithmetic at local noon so DST changes never skip a day.

nodes.label: Bundled server learning-quest.cjs
nodes.rationale: Committed because the plugin runs it directly; must be rebuilt before committing src/ changes.

nodes.label: commit-msg git hook
nodes.rationale: Blocks commits with src/ changes lacking docs or the rebuilt server bundle; [no-docs] for non-user-visible changes.

nodes.label: Learning Quest plugin
nodes.rationale: Calm gamified daily learning habit: discipline without overwhelm; one sitting a day capped at 60 minutes; user owns the record as Markdown in their Obsidian vault.

nodes.label: Quest pane
nodes.rationale: The pane only reads today.json and never changes the quest; buttons send prompts to Claude.

nodes.label: Today's Quest daily-note section
nodes.rationale: Regenerated each time, so plain bullets instead of checkboxes that would be un-ticked.

nodes.label: What gets written to your notes
nodes.norm_label: what gets written to your notes

nodes.label: Write rules (no network in save, single writer, atomic writes, backups, GENERATED marker)
nodes.norm_label: write rules (no network in save, single writer, atomic writes, backups, generated marker)

nodes.label: Today's reading stays put (picks stored)
nodes.rationale: First pick of the day is stored so refreshing feeds mid-day doesn't change it.

nodes.label: Fanout daily papers and blog
nodes.rationale: Curated paper wins on its track's day; item category decides track.

nodes.label: Saving a selection only saves
nodes.rationale: Fetching is a separate refresh_news call so saving is instant (no network inside a save).

nodes.label: Session flow: kickoff, read, goal block, close
nodes.norm_label: session flow: kickoff, read, goal block, close

nodes.label: Coach rules
nodes.rationale: Never plan past the cap, short messages one step at a time, no tangents, deadlines guide not whip, honest numbers calmly, never run git, write only through tools.

nodes.label: Over the cap earns no XP
nodes.norm_label: over the cap earns no xp

nodes.label: plugin.json version bump
nodes.rationale: Bump the plugin version for every change people should receive.

nodes.label: Public repo: never commit personal config
nodes.norm_label: public repo: never commit personal config

nodes.label: Import zod from zod/v3
nodes.rationale: The MCP SDK's types expect the zod/v3 subpath.

nodes.label: Docs are part of every feature rule
nodes.norm_label: docs are part of every feature rule
nodes.rationale: Every behaviour/tool/data change must update docs/ and the CHANGELOG in the same change so the docs never drift.

nodes.label: Plan is never stored (recomputed from today)
nodes.norm_label: plan is never stored (recomputed from today)
nodes.rationale: Recomputing the plan from today on every read means missed days self-heal.
